judgment: The confusion was not that eggs were not always present. The confusion was that eggs accumulated -- she didn'tknow why she found a bunch of eggs all at once.  I think the best solution to this is to ensure that initially the debris in the yard locks the chicken close to the starting location for a while.  We should make it much harder to expand than to manage already cleared land to support this.  And we need to indicate to the playere that clearing land causes exhertion.  Maybe different costs for clearing bushes and weeds versus clearing trees and clearing rocks.
